t0004-01.gloss: A meal and a route stop at the same mark.
t0004-01.rival_reading: A field crew might turn back at a restricted checkpoint and leave its meal unopened; the map does not show who set the restriction.

t0004-02.gloss: Dry fertilizer and loose granules travelled in one vehicle.
t0004-02.rival_reading: Officials could have moved ordinary farm supplies during a road closure; loose granules alone cannot identify a failed program.
